summary: Capstone Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a letter of intent with eBliss Global, Inc. to negotiate a 100% stock-for-stock acquisition intended as a tax-free reorganization under IRC Section 351. No price-per-share, premium, or deal value is stated. An exclusivity period runs from May 14 to July 31, 2026, with mutual no-shop and due diligence provisions. The filing is preliminary, lacking binding terms, board recommendation, or advisors. Watch for a definitive agreement by the exclusivity deadline.
